name: piflow_csv_parser
description: 将 UTF-8 CSV 文件解析为 Arrow 表格记录，可设置表头、分隔符和无表头时的列名。

header.description: 是否将输入的第一行视为表头，或是否输出表头。

delimiter.description: 字段分隔符；CSV 通常使用逗号，TSV 使用制表符。

schema.description: 无表头输入的列名定义，或本工具要求的数据结构描述。

inputs.source: UTF-8 CSV bytes, optionally including a header row.

outputs.result: Parse a UTF-8 CSV byte stream into string-valued records.

header.description: 是否将输入的第一行视为表头，或是否输出表头。

schema.description: 无表头输入的列名定义，或本工具要求的数据结构描述。

documentation.example_job:
# Replace the example Item paths with Items in your target catalog.
name: Parse a UTF-8 CSV byte stream into string-valued records.
steps:
- id: read_source
  operator: read_item@1.0
  inputs: {}
  params:
    uri: context:/example/source.csv
    view: bytes
- id: process
  operator: piflow_csv_parser@1.0
  inputs:
    source: read_source
  params:
    header: true
    delimiter: ','
    schema: station_id,temperature,quality
outputs:
  result: process

name: galaxy_emboss_tranalign
description: 根据蛋白质比对结果构建对应的核苷酸比对。

inputs.source: UTF-8 bytes stream. Source coding DNA FASTA and reference aligned-protein FASTA must have the same unique IDs; output source order. Standard code, complete frame1 codons, protein gap becomes three dashes; every non-gap protein residue must equal its source codon translation, including stop. No ORF search or alternative codes. Both inputs<=1000000 total characters and10000 records.
inputs.reference: UTF-8 bytes stream. Source coding DNA FASTA and reference aligned-protein FASTA must have the same unique IDs; output source order. Standard code, complete frame1 codons, protein gap becomes three dashes; every non-gap protein residue must equal its source codon translation, including stop. No ORF search or alternative codes. Both inputs<=1000000 total characters and10000 records.

outputs.result: Project aligned proteins into a codon-preserving nucleotide alignment. Source coding DNA FASTA and reference aligned-protein FASTA must have the same unique IDs; output source order. Standard code, complete frame1 codons, protein gap becomes three dashes; every non-gap protein residue must equal its source codon translation, including stop. No ORF search or alternative codes. Both inputs<=1000000 total characters and10000 records.

name: Project aligned proteins into a codon-preserving nucleotide alignment.
steps:
- id: read

    view: bytes

  params: {}
outputs:
  result: process

other_path.description: 第二份输入文件的工作区相对路径，通常用于比较或联合分析。

_input_filename.description: 输入原文件的文件名，须保留真实扩展名，例如 sample.nc。单文件在工作区内保存为 inputs/sample.nc；多文件传输包请填写 .zip 文件名。

_execution_timeout.description: 本次工具执行的超时时间，单位秒，超时会终止处理。

inputs.source: 上游传入的单个文件或 ZIP 文件包；单文件通过 _input_filename 保留扩展名，文件参数使用 inputs/文件名。

outputs.result: ZIP 结果包，包含 result.json、输入文件和生成文件；可连接后续文件处理算子。
